user.title: Choose data sources
user.description: This experimental integration is strictly read-only. Open Platform authentication and one authorized-plant count request are implemented. Local eManager remains an architecture placeholder.

open_platform.title: Elekeeper Open Platform
open_platform.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret of a released Elekeeper Open Platform app. Home Assistant verifies the credentials and performs one read-only authorized-plant list request. Secrets and access tokens are excluded from diagnostics.

local_emanager.title: Local eManager placeholder
local_emanager.description: The confirmed local architecture uses eManager/BSaj. The exact read-only transport request is not sufficiently confirmed, so this alpha asks for no host, port, unit ID or other connection details. Submit to create a placeholder entry.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Elekeeper Open Platform
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current App ID and App Secret. The app must be released before Home Assistant can connect.

error.source_required: Select at least one data source.
error.invalid_auth: The App ID or App Secret was rejected.
error.app_not_enabled: The developer app is not released. Release it in the SAJ developer portal and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the SAJ Elekeeper Open Platform.
error.rate_limited: The SAJ Open Platform rate limit was reached. Try again later.
error.unknown: The SAJ Open Platform returned an unexpected response.
